arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_006"
FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN race AS r ON s."XCL_025" = r."XCL_016"
INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s."XCL_023" = c."XCL_005"
WHERE r."XCL_017" = 'Human'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha
    INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003"
    WHERE a."XCL_004" = 'Durability'
      AND ha."XCL_011" < 50
      AND s."XCL_018" = ha."XCL_009"
  )
  AND s."XCL_028" > 0.8 * (
    SELECT AVG(s2."XCL_028")
    FROM superhero AS s2
    INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s2."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014"
    WHERE p."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_006" FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN race AS r ON s."XCL_025" = r."XCL_016" INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s."XCL_023" = c."XCL_005" WHERE r."XCL_017" = 'Human' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hero_attribute AS ha INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003" WHERE a."XCL_004" = 'Durability' AND ha."XCL_011" < 50 AND s."XCL_018" = ha."XCL_009") AND s."XCL_028" > 0.8 * (SELECT AVG("__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0") FROM (SELECT DISTINCT s2."XCL_028" AS "__grain_value_0", "s2"."XCL_018" AS "__grain_value_1" FROM superhero AS s2 INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s2."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014" WHERE p."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics') AS __ontology_entity_grain)

FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN race AS r ON s."XCL_025" = r."XCL_016"

WHERE r."XCL_017" = 'Human'

    INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s2."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014"
